reason: Combined June 2004 booklet 9700_s04_ms.pdf: the page headers of pdf pages 8-14 are misprinted '9700 4' although they are Paper 2 mark scheme pages (printed 'Page 3'-'Page 9'; content is Paper 2 questions 2-6, e.g. 2(a)(i)-(v) producers/population/community/ecosystem/primary consumers, 6(a) mitosis), so the component filter took them as Paper 4 and the splitter keyed the Paper 4 questions 2-6 from Paper 2 text. They are skipped; Paper 4's own mark scheme is pdf pages 18-24 (printed 'Page 1'-'Page 7', each question headed 'Question N'). Second fix: in this PDF the glyphs of the printed part labels render about 3 pt lower than their text-layer boxes, so the automatic label masks (text box + 1 pt) leave the bottom of the '(a)'/'(b)' parentheses as small stray marks at the top-left of the Q5.a, Q5.b, Q6.a, Q6.b, Q7.a and Q7.b crops. These are the remnants of the printed key labels (furniture, not marking content); each label's rendered ink is whited out in full with a hand mask (p22 (a) y161.8-172.1, (b) y427.4-437.7; p23 (a) y187.0-197.4, (b) y428.5-438.8; p24 (a) y141.8-152.2, (b) y369.4-379.8).
